note: Declared HS 847490 (parts of machinery for sorting/screening/cement plant) is corroborated by the actual customs line HS 84749000 on BOL 8014795 (cement mill spare parts, knee joints) — HS matches, no correction needed. Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India-origin export B/Ls to Russia, Senegal, Guinea and Saudi Arabia/UAE, with the most recent record 2026-02-08. Note the trade is spare parts for cement plants (Pfeiffer MVR mills, hydraulic valves, fasteners) — consistent with the claimed 'metallurgy and mining' industry only loosely; it is cement-plant MRO supply, not mining equipment. Legal name 'SAMPAT KUMAR MISHRA' is not verifiable from the customs data seen (records show only the trade name and address 'AMRIT COLONY, BHARHUT NAGAR'); no CIN/PAN found, so ownership is unconfirmed. Caveat on the source: ImportKey free view exposes only 5 of the 203 claimed rows, so the full shipment history and the exact count are unverified; the 5 visible rows are internally consistent (dates, ports, B/L numbers, HS codes) and are treated as genuine.
